tasks.subject: Task 0: Add meetings.description column
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A nullable `description text` column on `meetings` so officers can write summaries.

**Files:** Create `supabase/migrations/20260710000000_add_meetings_description.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:** nullable `description text` added to `public.meetings`; idempotent via `IF NOT EXISTS`.

**Verify:** `supabase migration up`

```json:metadata

```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure term/aggregation/pagination helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Timezone-safe term logic, per-term aggregation, and pagination math as pure unit-tested functions.

**Files:** Create `lib/stats-terms.ts`, `lib/stats-terms.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:** getTerm EST-safe; termBounds per season; academicYearTerms current-AY keys; buildTermSummaries per-term+all-time; pageRange/hasMore/percentage edge cases.

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/stats-terms.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/stats-terms.ts", "lib/stats-terms.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/stats-terms.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["getTerm EST-safe month classification", "termBounds correct per season", "academicYearTerms returns current AY keys", "buildTermSummaries per-term + all-time totals", "pageRange/hasMore/percentage edge cases"]}
```
